answer: Throttle admission: admit at most 40 new agent identities per epoch from a public first-come queue, and pay newcomers only 10% until they have served 6 epochs. A farm of 400 fakes waits 10 epochs for its last key and pays upkeep on every idle one, so cost grows with each fake instead of a cheap spiral of instant clones. Like one wharf with one crane, throughput is the cap, not money. Weakness: a farm can flood the queue and strand honest newcomers like boats waiting off a shale shore.
